title: Erase all data says it worked even when saved data copies in the phone's temporary folder could not be deleted
what: Erase all data also clears the app's temporary folder, where exported workout sheets, data files and picked pictures sit. Each file delete there that fails is ignored one by one, so the step still counts as done. The member is told the phone is back to new, and no 'left behind' line names it, while full copies of their data can still sit in that folder.
expected: A file in the temporary folder that could not be deleted makes that step count as failed, so the erase names it and the member can try again.
how_often: rarely (only when a file delete fails)
fix_line: Stop ignoring each failed delete in the temporary folder step, so the erase reports it like the other files.

title: If the copy kept before a restore cannot be read, Undo restore disappears with no word
what: Before a Google Drive restore the app keeps a copy of the phone's own data so Undo restore can put it back. If that copy later cannot be read, the app quietly deletes it and the Undo restore button just goes away. The member is never told their own data copy was lost, and nothing is noted.
expected: An unreadable copy is kept and the member is told Undo restore is no longer possible (and why), with a note for support.
how_often: rarely (only when the copy is damaged)
fix_line: Keep a damaged copy, write a note, and tell the member Undo is unavailable instead of hiding the button.

title: After Undo restore, Undo can come back after a restart if the old copy could not be removed
what: When Undo restore finishes, the app removes the copy it used. If that removal fails it is ignored. The button hides for now, but on the next start the old copy is found again and Undo restore shows again; tapping it would put the phone back to the old data a second time (the confirm does warn about newer workouts).
expected: A copy that could not be removed is noted and not offered again as a fresh Undo.
how_often: rarely (only when a file delete fails)
fix_line: Mark the copy as used inside the data, or note and retry the removal, so it is never offered twice.

title: After removing the demo or undoing an import, records can stay wrong with no word if their rebuild fails
what: Removing the demo data and undoing an import both rebuild the member's personal records for the workouts that stay. If that rebuild fails, nothing is shown and nothing is noted; the records list misses bests until the member edits or logs that exercise again.
expected: A failed record rebuild is noted and retried at the next start, so the records list is put right without the member doing anything.
who: members who remove the demo or undo an import
fix_line: Write a note and queue the record rebuild again at next start, like the other start-up repairs.
